subject.title: fix(memory-core): clear daily-ingestion sqlite namespace on dreaming repair

question: Should `memory status --fix` and doctor dreaming repair clear the migrated `dreaming-daily-ingestion` SQLite namespace whenever they archive the dreaming session corpus or legacy session-ingestion artifact?
rationale: The code change is narrow and symmetric with current audit behavior, but it deliberately deletes persisted workspace ingestion bookkeeping under an explicit repair action, so maintainer intent should confirm the repair semantic before merge.

options.title: Accept Symmetric Repair
options.body: Merge this PR so explicit dreaming repair clears all three audited ingestion namespaces and later sweeps rebuild daily bookkeeping.

options.title: Preserve Daily Bookkeeping
options.body: Ask for a different repair path if daily-ingestion rows should survive session-corpus repair despite audit treating them as ingestion state.

recommendation.title: Accept Symmetric Repair
recommendation.body: Merge this PR so explicit dreaming repair clears all three audited ingestion namespaces and later sweeps rebuild daily bookkeeping.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman introduced the dreaming repair surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for the repair semantic choice.
